. Edit boards and schematics through the backplane MCP tool `kicad_ipc` {path, type, message}: Backplane runs one headless KiCad per project and sends your command to it over KiCad's IPC API (type is the protobuf command, e.g. `kiapi.board.commands.GetItems`; message is its fields as JSON; `kicad_ipc_status` shows the server, its version and the commands it has). Headless KiCad has no selection or view state: always pass explicit item IDs (KIIDs from GetItems), wrap edits in BeginCommit/EndCommit, then SaveDocument; unsaved work is undone with EndCommit CMA_DROP.
